title: #afreekyintroduction #atlantictheatercompany #djmondayblue #freekydee...
transcript: A Freeky Introduction at Atlantic Theater Company has a little bit of everything. It feels like a cross between a DJ set, a poetry slam, a narrative solo piece, and even a sermon. Our host Freeky Dee, accompanied by DJ Monday Blue, takes us on a journey to find our inner freek, which is synonymous with inner freedom and being true to yourself among those who don't understand you. I enjoyed the immersive feel and the crowd work by Freeky Dee that quickly loosened everybody up with charisma and humor, and I thought the material was quite funny — if you were wondering, the show is also freaky in that it is quite suggestive at times. I think there are some improvements they can make to the pacing throughout previews, but otherwise it's in really solid shape. Most of the writing is accessible, but the structure of the show is pretty out there. It goes from one segment to the next with pretty much no transitions, and it consistently has you wondering where it's going. It all comes together at the end, but overall this might be a little too unstructured for some people to get into it. I think if you're just along for the ride like last night's audience was, you'll find there's a lot to enjoy, though I'd also point out that the quality of the audience can be a huge factor to the experience, so be prepared to contribute to the vibe. With that, another program for my collection.
